name: How do I prepare an inherited property for sale, especially if it needs repairs?

mainEntity.name: How do I prepare an inherited property for sale, especially if it needs repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preparing an inherited property for sale often involves decluttering, cleaning, and potentially making necessary repairs. Focus on improvements that offer the best return on investment, such as minor cosmetic updates, rather than major renovations, unless the property is significantly distressed. Kelby Contreras works with clients across Miami-Dade and Broward Counties and can offer specific guidance on local market preferences, suggesting which updates would most appeal to buyers in your area and help maximize your sale price, without overspending on unnecessary repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare the property by decluttering, cleaning, and making essential repairs. Focus on cost-effective updates that appeal to local buyers.
